title: Sequencing: hearing order
bodyMd:
Five hearings are held one at a time in five consecutive slots. Each hearing occurs exactly once.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Ash, Birch, Cedar, Elm, Fir.

- Ash must precede Cedar.
- Birch must be immediately followed by Elm.
- Fir must not be in position 1.
